description: New category definitions to expand from 30 to 100 total categories. Each will eventually have 100 specialized roles with high-competency coder style cross-references.

new_categories.name: Physics & Simulation Systems
new_categories.description: Designing believable physics, collision, rigidbody, fluid, and simulation systems for games.
new_categories.focus: Grounded, performant, and fun-to-interact physics that serve gameplay.

new_categories.name: AI & NPC Behavior Systems
new_categories.description: Creating intelligent, believable, and scalable AI behaviors for NPCs, enemies, and companions.
new_categories.focus: Believable decision-making, pathfinding, group behavior, and long-term memory for characters.

new_categories.name: Quest, Mission & Narrative Delivery Systems
new_categories.description: Designing quest structures, mission flow, branching narratives, and player-driven story delivery.
new_categories.focus: Meaningful choices, clear objectives, emotional payoff, and seamless integration with gameplay.

new_categories.name: Economy, Progression & Player Growth Systems
new_categories.description: Building long-term player progression, economy loops, skill trees, and meaningful advancement.
new_categories.focus: Rewarding growth, balanced power curves, and systems that keep players engaged for years.

new_categories.name: Multiplayer Networking & Synchronization
new_categories.description: Designing robust, low-latency multiplayer systems, state sync, prediction, and reconciliation.
new_categories.focus: Fair, responsive, and scalable multiplayer experiences across platforms.

new_categories.name: Audio Design, Implementation & Spatial Systems
new_categories.description: Creating immersive audio systems, spatial audio, dynamic mixing, and procedural sound.
new_categories.focus: Audio that enhances emotion, provides feedback, and feels alive in the game world.

new_categories.name: Visual Effects, Particles & Rendering Systems
new_categories.description: Designing high-quality VFX, particle systems, shaders, and rendering pipelines.
new_categories.focus: Beautiful, performant visuals that support gameplay readability and emotional impact.

new_categories.name: Animation Systems & Character Performance
new_categories.description: Building animation pipelines, blending, IK, procedural animation, and character expressiveness.
new_categories.focus: Characters that move and emote believably while remaining performant.

new_categories.name: Asset Pipeline, Tooling & Production Systems
new_categories.description: Designing efficient asset pipelines, import tools, validation, and artist-friendly workflows.
new_categories.focus: Fast iteration, high quality, and scalable content production for large teams.

new_categories.name: Security, Anti-Cheat & Integrity Systems
new_categories.description: Protecting games from cheating, exploits, and maintaining fair play at scale.
new_categories.focus: Robust detection, prevention, and response systems without harming legitimate players.

new_categories.name: Localization, Internationalization & Cultural Adaptation
new_categories.description: Making games accessible and culturally appropriate across languages and regions.
new_categories.focus: High-quality translation, cultural sensitivity, and seamless multi-language support.

new_categories.name: Telemetry, Analytics & Data-Driven Design
new_categories.description: Building systems to collect, analyze, and act on player behavior data ethically.
new_categories.focus: Actionable insights that improve design while respecting player privacy.

new_categories.name: Live Events, Seasonal Content & Temporary Experiences
new_categories.description: Designing engaging limited-time events, seasons, and special content drops.
new_categories.focus: Fresh, exciting content that brings players back without fragmenting the core experience.

new_categories.name: Monetization Strategy, Ethics & Long-term Health
new_categories.description: Designing fair, sustainable monetization that respects players and supports the game long-term.
new_categories.focus: Ethical systems that align player enjoyment with business sustainability.
